who.description: Who this reel is for, concretely. e.g. 'college students curious about space'
who.title: Who

why_they_care.description: The itch this scratches for them: curiosity, usefulness, emotion
why_they_care.title: Why They Care

meaning.description: One plain sentence a non-technical viewer understands
meaning.title: Meaning

Perspective.description: A point from the discussion around the source (e.g. a Hacker News comment) that adds something.

point.description: The point, paraphrased in plain language
point.title: Point

origin.description: Where it came from, e.g. 'HN comment 4123456 by someuser'
origin.title: Origin

verified.description: True only if the article itself (or a cited source) supports it; unverified points are opinions and must be presented as such
verified.title: Verified

Perspective.title: Perspective

Review.description: Editor pass over a machine-drafted idea.

by.description: Who reviewed: model name or person
by.title: By

changes.description: What was changed and why, one line each
changes.title: Changes

concerns.description: Open doubts a human should settle before production
concerns.title: Concerns

Review.title: Review

type.description: Where the idea came from: manual, hackernews, url, book, video, ...
type.title: Type

ref.description: Link, title or pointer to the source (for Hacker News: the discussion page)
ref.title: Ref

url.description: The article or page the idea is based on
url.title: Url

title.description: Title of the source as published
title.title: Title

material.description: Folder holding the downloaded source: article text, comments, digest
material.title: Material

raw.description: Original snippet as captured, before it was shaped into an idea
raw.title: Raw

meta.description: Source-specific extras, e.g. HN id, points, comment count
meta.title: Meta

SourceDigest.description: Everything worth keeping from the source, so the idea can be reworked without re-reading the article.

summary.description: What the article says, in 4-8 plain sentences
summary.title: Summary

facts.description: Every checkable claim the article makes, one per line
facts.title: Facts

numbers.description: Figures with their unit and what they measure
numbers.title: Numbers

glossary.description: Jargon the viewer will not know
glossary.title: Glossary

truncated.description: True if the article was longer than what was processed
truncated.title: Truncated

SourceDigest.title: SourceDigest

description: One reel idea. Every capture source produces this same structure.

essence.description: The core of the reel in 1-2 sentences: the single thing a viewer walks away with
essence.title: Essence

format.description: educational = teaches one concept; story = narrative with a turn; trivia = question(s) the viewer tries to answer
format.title: Format

hook.description: Opening angle: the question, surprise or stake that stops the scroll
hook.title: Hook

angle.description: The take that makes this reel ours: the quirky, relatable way into the topic
angle.title: Angle

background.description: What the viewer must know first, assuming no prior knowledge
background.title: Background

analogies.description: Everyday comparisons that make the idea click (chai stall, cricket, ...)
analogies.title: Analogies

so_what.description: Why this matters to the viewer's own life, money, job or phone
so_what.title: So What

share_line.description: The one line the viewer can repeat to a friend to sound in the loop
share_line.title: Share Line

key_points.description: Facts to teach / plot beats in order / trivia questions with answers. The script may only use facts listed here or in essence
key_points.title: Key Points

tone.description: e.g. curious, playful, dramatic, calm, funny
tone.title: Tone

cta.description: Closing call to action; empty = a generic follow line
cta.title: Cta

perspectives.description: Points from the discussion that teach or add a new view
perspectives.title: Perspectives

digest.description: Everything captured from the source article

title: Idea
